content_sections.heading: About VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital
content_sections.text: Vardhman Mahavir Medical College & Safdarjung Hospital is a medical college and hospital in New Delhi, and its letterhead places it under the Government of India's Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. This post sits in the Department of Obstetrics & Gynaecology and serves the NPAC-INDIA study.

content_sections.heading: VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Project Technical Staff Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits, and it is based on the candidate's experience, qualifications and skill set. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Project Technical Staff Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Below 35 years. Bachelor's Degree in public health, social science, life sciences, health care management or a related field from a recognized institution or university. Ability to read, write, communicate and type in English. Ability to use Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Ability to communicate, read and write in the local language. Preference may be given to experience in data collection, data analysis, data monitoring and similar work. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board or University and full-time. Any experience required should be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification for the post. The qualification, experience and other requirements are relaxable at the discretion of the competent authority for candidates who are otherwise suitable. See the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility details of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening: if a large number of applications are received, candidates are limited to those possessing higher or relevant qualifications. Written test/Interview: only shortlisted candidates are called. Requests to change the written test or interview schedule will not be entertained under any circumstances. A candidate not found suitable for this post can be offered a lower post on the recommendation of the Selection Committee.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary/contractual, for the specified period of time and based on the project. Duty hours are 9 am to 4 pm.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Project Technical Staff Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Although the notice is headed Walk-in-Interview, its terms ask candidates to send their details by email and say that only shortlisted candidates will be called. Prepare your current CV, a recent color photo and three references. Write this subject line: "Application for the position PTS (NPAC-INDIA STUDY)". Email everything to [email protected] . Incomplete applications will stand summarily rejected without any reasons being given. If shortlisted, attend at the HOD Office, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi. The address section of the notice also lists Ward-6. For enquiries, the notice lists contact numbers 26730240 and 26730263.

faq.question: Q1. Is experience compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: Experience is not listed as a mandatory requirement. Work in data collection, data analysis or data monitoring is something the notice says may be given preference.

faq.question: Q2. Who needs a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Persons working in a Govt. or Public Sector undertaking should produce it at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q3. Will travel costs for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No. TA/DA is not admissible for appearing in the interview, and this includes SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What happens if no suitable candidate is found?
faq.answer: The call for application stays open. Once a suitable candidate is found, the recruitment notice will be closed on the hospital's website.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates hear about the results?
faq.answer: All results will be published on the website, and all future communications will be only through email.

faq.question: Q6. Can canvassing affect my application?
faq.answer: Yes. Canvassing in any form is a disqualification.

faq.question: Q7. Which computer skills does the post require?
faq.answer: Candidates need to be able to use Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, and to type in English.
